title: Battle of Playa Honda
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Playa Honda", at revision 1370586246, opens: "The naval Second Battle of Playa Honda, was the first of three known minor conflicts during the Eighty Years' War between the Dutch Republic and Spain held in Playa Honda in the Philippines." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1933282, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1617 naval battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
